The shell is a web_dashboard with the persistent dark left sidebar, top header bar with breadcrumb Home / Student Portal / Orders, search, streak badge, notification bell, and user profile avatar Rahul Sharma (Pro Learner). In the sidebar, set 'Orders' as active with highlighted background and styling (matching {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_2}} and {{DATA:SCREEN:SCREEN_4}} navigation).

Screen Content requirements:
1. Breadcrumbs & Page Header:
   - Breadcrumb: Home / Student Portal / Orders
   - Header: 'Orders & Payments' with subtitle 'View payment receipts, manage invoices, and track enrollment transactions for your executive data cohorts.'
   - Right-side actions: 'Download All Invoices (ZIP)' button (outline), 'Billing Support' button.

2. KPI Mini-Cards row (3 cards):
   - Card 1: 'Total Spent' -> '₹14,997' (subtitle: 'Across 4 enrolled masterclasses', icon: payments or credit_card, subtle growth/trend badge)
   - Card 2: 'Completed Orders' -> '4' (subtitle: '100% successful clearance via Razorpay', icon: check_circle, green badge)
   - Card 3: 'Refunds / Disputes' -> '0' (subtitle: 'No active chargebacks or queries', icon: assignment_return, gray badge)
   - Card 4: 'Tax Invoices Available' -> '4 GST Invoices' (subtitle: 'Includes 18% input tax credit breakdown', icon: receipt_long)

3. Filter & Search Toolbar:
   - Search input: 'Search by Order ID (e.g. ORD-2024-0182) or course title...'
   - Status dropdown filter: 'All Statuses' (Paid, Pending, Failed, Refunded)
   - Date range selector: 'All Time (2024)'
   - Payment gateway: 'All Gateways (Razorpay / UPI / NetBanking)'
   - Right side: Clear filters action, and results count 'Showing 4 of 4 orders'

4. Orders & Transactions Data Table:
   Columns:
   - ORDER ID (e.g. ORD-2024-0182, font-mono font-semibold text-primary)
   - COURSE & DETAILS (Course thumbnail, Course title like 'Advanced Excel Masterclass: Dynamic Arrays & Financial Modeling', instructor 'CA Rohan Mehta', cohort badge)
   - DATE & TIME (e.g. 'Oct 14, 2024 • 14:28 IST')
   - AMOUNT (e.g. '₹4,999' font-mono font-semibold, subtitle 'Incl. 18% GST (₹762)')
   - PAYMENT METHOD ('UPI / Razorpay' with UPI/GPay/PhonePe or Visa icon badge)
   - STATUS (Pill badge: 'Paid' in green, 'Pending' in amber, 'Failed' in red, 'Refunded' in gray)
   - ACTIONS ('Download Invoice' PDF icon button, 'Get Help' link)

5. One Row Expanded Details (for ORD-2024-0182 - Advanced Excel Masterclass):
   - Visual accordion expanded sub-card beneath the row with subtle tinted background:
     - Left column: Transaction identifiers: Razorpay Payment ID 'pay_Qx8Lm2NpKl', Bank RRN / UTR number '428819283719', Billing entity: 'BICE Data Academy Pvt. Ltd. (GSTIN: 27AABCB1234F1Z5)', Billing address of student: 'Rahul Sharma, Bangalore, Karnataka'.
     - Middle column: Line item breakdown:
       - Course Tuition (Executive Tier): ₹4,236.44
       - CGST (9%): ₹381.28
       - SGST (9%): ₹381.28
       - Total Paid: ₹4,999.00
     - Right column: Invoice Actions & Policy Timeline:
       - Buttons: 'Download Tax Invoice (PDF)', 'Download Payment Receipt (Razorpay)', 'Email Invoice'
       - 7-Day Money-Back Guarantee status: 'Refund window ended on Oct 21, 2024 (Verified completed)' with a 3-step mini visual progress timeline: 'Order Placed (Oct 14)' -> 'Instant Payment Cleared (Oct 14)' -> 'Cohort Access Provisioned (Oct 14)'.

6. Other Orders in table:
   - Order 2: ORD-2024-0145 | SQL for Modern Data Analysis & Warehousing | Elena Rostova | Sep 22, 2024 | ₹4,299 | Card (Visa •••• 4012) via Razorpay | Status: Paid
   - Order 3: ORD-2024-0098 | Power Query & M-Code Automation: Enterprise ETL | Marcus Chen | Aug 05, 2024 | ₹2,999 | NetBanking (HDFC Bank) via Razorpay | Status: Paid
   - Order 4: ORD-2024-0042 | Python 3 for Financial Analysts | David Kalu | Jun 18, 2024 | ₹2,700 | UPI (GPay) via Razorpay | Status: Paid

7. Pagination & Empty State Preview:
   - Clean pagination bar at bottom: 'Showing 1 to 4 of 4 orders', Page 1 active.
   - Filter empty state preview callout: 'No matching orders found? Try resetting filters or search terms. [Clear filters]'

8. Help & GST Compliance Banner:
   - 'Need corporate invoice with your company GSTIN?'
   - Info callout explaining how to update enterprise GST details or reach the billing desk.
